# Prompt Sidequest

> Prompt Sidequest helps everyday people use AI for more than search: copy-paste prompts, no-code app/website build guides, no-code AI agent setups, and AI for gamers. Free prompt library, free 50-prompt PDF and newsletter, plus paid digital packs sold on Gumroad.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://promptsidequest.com/): overview, sample prompts, products
- [Free prompt library](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/): 10 free copy-paste prompts plus 16 step-by-step prompt guides by situation
- [AI agents for beginners](https://promptsidequest.com/agents/): what AI agents are and how to set one up without code
- [Free PDF: 50 Prompts for Real Life](https://promptsidequest.com/free/50-prompts.pdf): 16-page free prompt pack, six quests (everyday life, work, learning, building, agents, gaming)
- [Newsletter](https://promptsidequest.beehiiv.com/subscribe): free, hosted on beehiiv; subscribers get the 50-prompt pack

## Prompt guides
- [ChatGPT game master prompt for game night](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/ai-game-master/): Copy-paste prompts to have ChatGPT run a mystery tabletop adventure for game night with just paper and dice: setup, characters, scenes and a twist.
- [ChatGPT prompt to ask for a raise](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/ask-for-a-raise/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to build your case, script the conversation and write the email when you ask your boss for a raise.
- [Build a website with one AI prompt](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/build-a-website-with-ai/): Build a simple website with one AI prompt: a copy-paste prompt for a single HTML page, plus prompts to fix, polish and publish it free. No coding.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a complaint letter to a landlord](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/complaint-letter-to-landlord/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a calm, firm complaint letter to your landlord about repairs, mold, pests or noise, plus a follow-up plan.
- [ChatGPT prompt to dispute a bill](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/dispute-a-bill/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to dispute a medical, phone, utility or credit card bill: find errors, write the letter and plan the follow-up call.
- [Explain like I'm 5 prompt: learn anything in three levels](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/explain-like-im-5/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts that explain any topic like you're 5, then a teen, then a college student, and quiz you to check you got it.
- [ChatGPT prompt to get your security deposit back](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/get-security-deposit-back/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to document your move-out, challenge unfair deductions and write a firm security deposit demand letter to your landlord.
- [AI prompt for a hard conversation with your boss](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/hard-conversation-with-boss/): Free AI prompts to plan a hard conversation with your boss: raises, workload, feedback, mistakes. Get an opening line, talking points and practice.
- [ChatGPT prompt to make a monthly budget](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/make-a-monthly-budget/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to build a simple monthly budget from your real income and bills, find spending leaks and plan for irregular costs.
- [AI prompt to plan a week of meals on a budget](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/meal-plan-on-a-budget/): Copy-paste AI prompts to plan a week of cheap, realistic meals around your budget and pantry, then turn it into one grocery list and a prep plan.
- [ChatGPT prompt to plan a trip](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/plan-a-trip/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to plan a realistic day-by-day trip itinerary, set a travel budget, build a packing list and handle plans going wrong.
- [ChatGPT prompt to prepare for a job interview](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/prepare-for-a-job-interview/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to predict interview questions, build STAR answers from your real experience, run a mock interview and plan your questions.
- [ChatGPT prompt for RPG builds](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/rpg-build-planner/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to plan a video game character build: stats, skills, gear and unlock order for your playstyle, plus a patch check.
- [ChatGPT prompt to talk to your roommate about chores](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/talk-to-your-roommate/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to plan a calm talk with your roommate about dishes, cleaning, noise or bills, and handle it if they get defensive.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a cover letter](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/write-a-cover-letter/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a short cover letter that matches the job post, uses your real experience and sounds like you, not a robot.
- [ChatGPT prompt to write a resignation letter](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/write-a-resignation-letter/): Copy-paste ChatGPT prompts to write a short, professional resignation letter, plan your notice period and leave on good terms.
